news.q: In World Series Game 3 on Oct. 26, the Brewers set a postseason record with how many straight hits with two outs in one inning?
news.fact: They fueled an eight-run fifth in a 10-1 win and a 3-0 series lead.

news.q: Archaeologists say a wreck off Turkey's coast may be the world's oldest known shipwreck. About how many years old is it, to the nearest hundred?
news.fact: The previous record holder, off Dokos, Greece, is about 4,200 years old.
